extracted.name: Cream Cheese Cucumber Dip
extracted.description: Learn how to make this delicious cucumber with cream cheese dip recipe that is the perfect addition to any pretzel, vegetable, or chip side dish.
instruction_lines: In a bowl, thoroughly blend cream cheese, cucumber, onion, mayonnaise, and garlic salt. Cover and chill in the refrigerator until serving.
